messages: I have crushing chest pain that goes down my left arm and I am sweating.
rationale: Classic warning pattern: chest pain with arm spread, sweating, pressure.

messages: I have chest pain and I can't catch my breath.
rationale: Chest pain with difficulty breathing.

messages: This is the worst headache of my life, it came on all of a sudden.
rationale: Sudden worst-ever headache.

messages: My father feels dizzy and his face is drooping on one side.
rationale: Face droop is a stroke warning sign.

messages: My six-week-old baby has a fever.
rationale: Fever in a baby under 3 months.

messages: I am pregnant and have lower tummy pain with some vaginal bleeding.
rationale: Abdominal pain with bleeding in pregnancy.

messages: I cut my arm badly and the bleeding won't stop.
rationale: Uncontrolled bleeding.

messages: I don't want to live anymore, I keep thinking of killing myself.
rationale: Suicidal thoughts need immediate human support.

messages: He has a high fever, a stiff neck and seems confused.
rationale: Fever with stiff neck and confusion.

messages: Sharp stabbing chest pain for twenty minutes after a coughing fit.
rationale: Any chest pain needs same-day assessment; under 35 with no emergency features.

messages: My 3 year old has had a high fever for 3 days.
rationale: High fever for several days in a young child.

messages: The pain moved to my lower right side and I vomited, I feel feverish.
rationale: Lower right pain with fever and vomiting.

messages: My son is vomiting and has loose motions and cannot keep water down.
rationale: Cannot keep fluids down in a toddler.

messages: I fell and my wrist looks bent, I can't move it.
rationale: Possible fracture.

messages: Burning when I pee, a fever, and pain in my side.
rationale: Urinary symptoms with fever and flank pain.

messages: I hit my head yesterday, now I have a headache and vomited once.
rationale: Headache after head injury.

messages: I have had fever for five days now.
rationale: Fever lasting 5 days.

messages: I feel dizzy and my heart is racing.
rationale: Dizziness with abnormal heartbeat.

messages: I have had a fever for three days.
rationale: Manual's example: fever 3 days, no warning signs -> doctor visit.

messages: I have had a cough for ten days.
rationale: Cough lasting over a week.

messages: I have had stomach pain for two days, around the belly button.
rationale: Moderate abdominal pain for 2 days, no warning signs.

messages: I have had a new headache for four days.
rationale: New headache at 50+ lasting days.

messages: It burns when I urinate since yesterday.
rationale: Urinary symptoms: see doctor or teleconsult.

messages: Sore throat and fever for three days.
rationale: Fever with sore throat for 3 days.

messages: Diarrhoea for three days but I can drink fine.
rationale: Diarrhoea lasting 3 days.

messages: My grandfather has had a mild fever since yesterday.
rationale: Mild fever alone is low, but age 65+ raises it one level.

messages: I have had a slight fever since yesterday.
rationale: Short, mild fever without warning signs.

messages: I have had a mild cough for three days.
rationale: Short, mild cough.

messages: I have a mild headache since this morning.
rationale: Mild headache, no warning signs.

messages: My throat is a little sore since yesterday.
rationale: Mild, short sore throat.

messages: I vomited once and had loose stool, but I am drinking fine.
rationale: Mild, short, hydrating well.

messages: I scraped my knee on the road.
rationale: Minor graze.

messages: I feel a bit light-headed when I stand up fast.
rationale: Mild, short, no warning signs.

messages: Mild bloating and discomfort in my belly since yesterday.
rationale: Mild, short, no warning signs.
